User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Conversion/confirmation pages and the gated lead-magnet deliverables all
# carry <meta name="robots" content="noindex">, which is the only thing
# actually keeping them out of search. They are NOT Disallow'd here on
# purpose: noindex only works if Googlebot is allowed to crawl the page and
# see the tag. Disallowing a noindex page blocks that, and if the URL was
# ever indexed before noindex was added, or picks up a stray external link,
# it can get stuck in the index as a bare URL with no way for Google to
# recrawl it and drop it. See thank-you.php, appointment__confirmation.php
# and resources/guides/*.php for the noindex tags themselves.

# PDF lead magnets. Different case from the paragraph above: a PDF has no
# <meta noindex> equivalent, so Disallow is the only lever available, and it
# does not create the same stuck-URL risk because these files are never
# linked from crawlable markup in the first place — only revealed by JS after
# a form submits. This rule is scoped to *.pdf on purpose; it must never
# widen back to the whole resources/guides/ folder, which would re-trap the
# noindex'd HTML guides the comment above explains.
Disallow: /resources/guides/*.pdf

# Internals
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /components/
Disallow: /assets_backup/
Disallow: /practitioner-images_backup/

Sitemap: https://embracelives.com/sitemap.xml
